name: flux-biased rf-SQUID phase qubit (and Josephson photomultiplier)
question: Does the flux bias that removes the metastable well write the neighbouring well, and with which delay law?
assumptions: U = E_L (phi - phi_e)^2/2 - E_J cos(phi), ell = E_L/E_J = 0.1 (the device has 0.005; fewer wells keep the search finite)
time in units of the plasma period

provenance.source: Wendin, G., 'Quantum information processing with superconducting circuits: a review', Rep. Prog. Phys. 80, 106001 (2017), arXiv:1610.02208 (full text); Martinis, J. M., 'Superconducting phase qubits', Quantum Inf. Process. 8, 81 (2009) (full text, author manuscript from the UCSB group web page)
